detail: The preserved exploration used a 70% whole-recording overlap gate and selected a dataset9 alias. Only the validated revision and calibration_consensus_v2 mappings are authoritative. media_probe.json retains exploratory coarse offsets; never use those fields for label association.
Milling context is visible but coolant often hides exact tool contact and fine defects. No visual class-separability claim.
80–100 ms bounds are empirical acoustic engineering guards, not externally certified hardware or annotation confidence.
1–3 s feature update intervals/internal aggregation latency limit short-cut physical interpretation; table row counts are not independent raw vibration samples.
The 114 common-MTC examples and 39 raw-ACC examples overlap. Do not add or silently pool them.
Only two positive-containing pilot groups; physical tool/workpiece/session independence remains unresolved.
VM20i dataset1 S0 clipping approximately 14.23% across recording; S2 used for final alignment.
10 s CT spacing yields one sample in the pilot abnormal interval; no industry video.
VM20i S_Axis_Load has ROTARY_VELOCITY type but PERCENT units; source preserved without correction.
Observed speed/feed and experiment design may confound future predictors. Current numerical vectors are diagnostics only; a final predictor/controls protocol requires researcher review.
